Edition compass · Case 02 · Albrecht · Joint version 1.1 · 27 October 2026 · Material

Opportunities, risks and countermeasures

Editorial initial classification for the model case before additional measures. Plausibility is not a measured probability; effect means the benefit in terms of opportunities, an undesirable consequence in terms of risks. Unexplained conditions remain outside the quadrants. The exploration and theme maps explain additional dependencies.

Change of methods

Opportunity · Plausibility unexplained · Impact far reaching

A better model can provide new insights; its professional gain is open before the trial.

How does Git help? A test branch keeps the new modeling trialable separately. Versioned data, schemas and migration scripts make differences understandable. A Git tag designates a specific version; a tape release also requires the appropriate index and software levels.

Action: Choose a representative test passage, document the impact and care costs, examine the technical and technical aspects and keep the decision with its scope.

Responsible for: Bandredaktion, scientific-technical editorial and authorized edition commission

Review

Chance · Plausibility higher · Effect far reaching

Technical review is provided and can improve the edition beyond individual positions.

How does Git help? A clearly marked test bench and the comparison to the revision combine feedback and editing. Protected test packages can be generated from versioned sources.

Action: Check stand, back channel, competent authority and deal with revisions; coordinate schedules with the publisher.

Responsible for: Expert person, band editor, general editor and publisher's editor

Research and publishing

Opportunity · Plausibility unexplained · Impact far reaching

The cooperation is interesting; objects and approvals are still unexplained.

How does Git help? After an agreed approval, a curated data package can be accurately identified and published in its own public repo. Private history and confidential feedback will not be exported.

Action: Check concrete agreements, separate types of data, negotiate additional access if necessary and document each approval in a comprehensible manner.

Responsible for: Project management, competent legal advice, authorised bodies and publishing house

Risk · Plausibility unexplained · Effect far reaching

Restoration

Risk · Plausibility unexplained · Effect far reaching

A complete reconstruction is initially untested. Its reliability must not be assumed.

How does Git help? A transferable version history preserves file versions and its relationships. It can facilitate restart, but does not replace DB snapshots, context, rights decisions, and available transformations.

Action: Check archive packages for completeness, regularly test restoration, document missing components and institutionally secure transfers.

Responsible for: Infrastructure providers, archive services and new scientific editors

Process learning and control

Chance · Plausibility higher · Effect far reaching

Recurring processes provide starting points for process learning when the analysis is technically appropriate.

How does Git help? Close reading of individual stands with git blame, git show and comparisons reconstructs the change of a position. Analyses of many places show the accumulation after a selective register reconciliation. Together they allow precise monitoring; the technical assignment of changes is not a proof of guilt.

Action: Release the transition test H06 immediately, revise the comment tool in parallel and decrease the return journey with regression test. Then recheck the manual rule. Clear new process analyses according to employee agreement and analysis sheet in advance.

Responsible for: Editorial, staff and, where appropriate, their representations, coordination, technical and legally responsible bodies
